```{=html}
<div class="page-intro">
  <h1>Projects</h1>
  <p class="subtitle">Research and data science work in biostatistics &amp; bioinformatics</p>
</div>

<div class="project-list">

  <div class="project-item">
    <h3>Age Effect Explorer: Interactive Transcriptomics Browser</h3>
    <p>
      An interactive R Shiny application for exploring tissue-specific age- and sex-associated gene
      expression changes across 54 human tissues using GTEx v10 bulk RNA-seq data, applying
      multivariable linear regression and FDR correction across thousands of genes.
      Co-first-author publication in <em>Bioinformatics Advances</em> (2026).
    </p>
    <span class="project-tag">R &middot; Shiny &middot; SQL &middot; Linear Regression &middot; FDR Correction</span>
  </div>

  <div class="project-item">
    <h3>EEG Biomarker Validation in Epilepsy Drug Trials</h3>
    <p>
      Analyzed multi-center epilepsy trial data to compare seizure-free survival across treatment arms
      and evaluate EEG spike activity as a predictive biomarker, using survival analysis, Cox
      proportional hazards modeling, and diagnostic accuracy metrics in SAS.
    </p>
    <span class="project-tag">SAS &middot; R &middot; Survival Analysis &middot; Cox PH &middot; Biomarker Validation</span>
  </div>

  <div class="project-item">
    <h3>Urban Wild Bee Resistome Analysis</h3>
    <p>
      Built a complete bioinformatics pipeline integrating four ARG databases (CARD, RGI, Resfams,
      SARG) to identify 1,841 high-confidence antibiotic resistance genes across urban wild bee gut
      microbiomes, characterizing horizontal gene transfer risk and environmental contamination patterns.
    </p>
    <span class="project-tag">Bioinformatics &middot; Metagenomics &middot; Pipeline Development &middot; Diversity Analysis</span>
  </div>

  <div class="project-item">
    <h3>Reproducible Health Insurance Data Analysis</h3>
    <p>
      Developed an end-to-end reproducible analysis pipeline for a real-world health insurance dataset,
      demonstrating industry best practices including Docker containerization, Makefile automation,
      R Markdown reporting, and version control.
    </p>
    <span class="project-tag">R &middot; Docker &middot; Makefile &middot; R Markdown &middot; Reproducible Research</span>
  </div>

  <div class="project-item">
    <h3>Oncology Biomarker Validation</h3>
    <p>
      Engineered a Random Forest classifier achieving greater than 90% AUC for predicting treatment
      response in oncology patients, using PCA to reduce over 300 clinical and molecular features and
      supporting weekly clinical team reporting.
    </p>
    <span class="project-tag">Python &middot; R &middot; Random Forest &middot; PCA &middot; Cross-Validation</span>
  </div>

  <div class="project-item">
    <h3>Environmental Resistance Gene Forecasting</h3>
    <p>
      Applied LSTM time series modeling to forecast antibiotic resistance gene prevalence under varying
      pesticide exposure scenarios, and built an XGBoost classifier (89% accuracy) to predict resistance
      risk from microbial and land-use features.
    </p>
    <span class="project-tag">Python &middot; LSTM &middot; XGBoost &middot; Time Series &middot; Environmental Health</span>
  </div>

</div>
```
